name: agentic-maker
description: Design agent-facing tools (CLIs, scripts, MCP servers, skills) and test them by derailment: run a fresh agent, read the whole execution, fix the text that caused each drift, rerun.

interface.shortDescription: Design, build and audit CLIs, MCP servers and skills for agents
interface.longDescription: Design agent-facing tools (CLIs, MCP servers, skills), build or repair them in the order that matters, audit them with read-only probes, and hand over a derail test that runs fresh agents against them. Skills you start by name: audit, design, build-cli, build-mcp, build-skill; derail runs from Claude Code.
defaultPrompt: Use $build-mcp to add a tool to this server
Use $design to sketch a CLI for agents
